notes.title: Interface Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I continue to work on improving the user experience. However, before adding new pop-up tips, I needed to deal with bugs in the current interface. This is what today's patch was dedicated to. Here's what has been fixed:[/p][list][*][p]When switching window mode, containers now scale correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]The unit characteristics container is now used both in battle and in the store.[/p][/*][*][p]The unit characteristics container is displayed in battle next to the cursor, not in the center of the screen as before.[/p][/*][*][p]When hovering over an opponent, the cells that he can attack no longer include cells with obstacles.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Retreat" button can no longer be pressed during the transition between rounds, so as not to disrupt animations in the battle scene.[/p][/*][*][p]The victory congratulation after ten victories has been returned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the hearts animation when transitioning to play-offs.[/p][/*][*][p]The placeholders for the player's name, opponent's name, and Doppelganger are now translated to the interface language.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Community” button now leads to the page corresponding to the selected interface language.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the attack sound of PRIEST.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the gold display on the battle results screen when the player is defeated in the first battle.[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Unit Upgrades
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Returning from vacation with a new patch. It's not that big, but it radically changes the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/d126cba319ce55c7ee0e353a8a3d1b9562e19de4.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Unit Upgrades[/h3][p]The main innovation is the unit upgrade system. All creatures in the game are now divided into five archetypes: Adept, Bruiser, Guardian, Marksman, and Sentinel. From the very beginning, the player has all five available for purchase — these are our old friends: Crafter, Lumberjack, Blacksmith, Hunter, and Peasant. After each victory, the player can choose a new unit that replaces the previous version of the same archetype. Each subsequent unit is stronger than the previous one in its archetype. In total, four such upgrades are possible — thus, the game still has 5 levels. Only now these are not rarities, but precisely upgrades.[/p][h3]New Units[/h3][p]To support the new system, many new creatures have been added to the game. Now their total number has reached 36. I won't describe each one — I'll give you the opportunity to discover them yourself. The only thing I want to note: Angels and Archangels have appeared in the game.[/p][h3]Appearance of Glory[/h3][p]Another important change is the glory system. Now the number of units available for purchase is limited not by their availability in the store, but by the amount of glory required for hiring. Unlike gold, glory is not spent, but acts as a limiter on the maximum number of units of one type. It encourages the player to create diverse army compositions instead of buying one strongest unit. The amount of glory grows after each victory.[/p][h3]Gold Accrual[/h3][p]Interaction with gold has become much simpler. No more refunds for lost troops or rewards for destroyed enemies. Now gold is accrued each time you enter the store, based on the number of victories the player has. More victories — more gold. Armies also do not save between battles: after each battle, the player buys anew. Together with the new opponent matching system based on the number of victories, this makes the game maximally balanced. You always fight only against players with the same level of gold, glory, and upgrades.[/p][h3]Small Interface Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]The unit characteristics panel now displays its archetype, as well as the price in gold and glory.[/p][/*][*][p]The unit disband window shows the amount of gold the player will receive.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "-" and "+" buttons next to the number of units in the store.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Further Plans[/h3][p]I have carefully studied your feedback on the complexity and confusion of the game. Therefore, the next updates will be aimed at making it clearer and friendlier for both beginners and experienced players. I really hope that these changes will help an even larger number of people enjoy the game.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Major Changes and New Platform
notes.notes: [h3]Hello everyone! 👋[/h3][p][/p][p]This update is a bit delayed because I was preparing a version for [b]itch.io[/b]. Now you can play the demo [b]Knight's Errand[/b] right in your browser or on your phone. I hope this attracts more players, and the variety of opponents will become even greater. In addition, we have made many changes to the game and fixed a lot of bugs.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay[/b] ⚔️[/h3][p][/p][p][b]💰 Updated Economy:[/b] Now the gold for lost squads and for defeated enemies depends on the course of the battle. This makes early defeats less painful, and late ones more tense, as compensation for losses decreases, and the reward for victory grows.[/p][p][b]📈 Reward for Defeats:[/b] If the player suffers a series of defeats, the reward for defeated enemies increases slightly for them to avoid a "death spiral". I'm not sure yet how balanced this is, so the mechanic may change in the future.[/p][p][b]🪙 Store Scaling:[/b] The number of units available for purchase now grows with the number of battles. This allows creating armies from cheap creatures even in late stages, adding variety to tactics and making the store fairer.[/p][p][b]🔄 Full Cost Refund:[/b] When disbanding a squad in the store, its full cost is now returned.[/p][p][b]🏆 Shared Leaderboard:[/b] [b]Play-off[/b] now uses a single leaderboard for all platforms — [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Itch.io[/b]. Opponent armies are also stored in a common repository.[/p][p][b]📊 Access to Rating:[/b] Now the game has a [b]full leaderboard[/b], not just the player's personal rank.[/p][p][b]🤖 Offline Mode:[/b] Even without an internet connection, battles continue, but against a doppelganger army.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Screen Resolution[/b] 🖥️[/h3][p][/p][p][b]📐 Scale Change:[/b] The game's resolution has been changed from [b]480x270[/b] to [b]630x460[/b]. On large monitors, the game now looks much better, and it gives me more flexibility to work with the interface. On mobile devices, the game seems a bit small now, but I plan to add mode switching in the future.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Interface[/b] ⚙️[/h3][p][/p][p][b]🎮 New Main Menu:[/b] The game now has a main menu with buttons for feedback and adding to the wishlist.[/p][p][b]⛓️ Animated Menus:[/b] All main menus are now hung on chains and appear and disappear effectively. I hope fans of old strategies will like this.[/p][p][b]💨 Separate Initiative:[/b] The [b]initiative[/b] indicator is now displayed separately from the number of units, allowing for a quicker assessment of the battlefield situation.[/p][p][b]➡️ Disappearing Indicator:[/b] After a squad's turn, its initiative disappears to not take up space on the screen.[/p][p][b]💡 Highlighting Information:[/b] Panels with the number of units and initiative now come to the foreground when hovering over a unit, allowing quick assessment of its stats without obscuring the rest of the screen.[/p][p][b]✨ Button Highlighting:[/b] In the store, when the player has no squads in the army, not only units are highlighted, but also buttons for their purchase. This will help newcomers better understand the interface.[/p][p][b]🖱️ Improved Controls:[/b] Combinations [b]Shift+LMB[/b], [b]Ctrl+LMB[/b] and double-click now deselect the original squad after splitting it. From a [b]UI/UX[/b] perspective, this is more logical.[/p][p][b]🪙 Slider Limitation:[/b] The unit quantity slider in the store now moves only up to the maximum available for purchase, making the process more convenient if gold is insufficient.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Bugs[/b] 🐞[/h3][p][/p][p][b]✅ Correct Damage:[/b] Potential damage for blocked ranged units is now calculated correctly.[/p][p][b]🗑️ Disappeared Copies:[/b] Dragging a squad in the store no longer leaves a copy with 0 units.[/p][p][b]🎶 Looped Sounds:[/b] All background sound effects are now looped and do not stop after the first playback.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Total Battle Background Overhaul
notes.notes: [h2]Hello everyone![/h2][p]I'm excited to introduce the new development diaries. This update focuses on visuals and artificial intelligence.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/bb51cbd00763272c65530efa8d56480d5dc17b99.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Updated Battle Backgrounds 🏞️[/h2][p]The [b]battle scene backgrounds[/b] have been completely revamped. They are now much more detailed, varied, and vibrant. Four new backgrounds are available so far, with more to come in future patches. Existing ones will also keep improving. Each background now comes with matching [b]sound design[/b], further immersing you in the battle atmosphere. [b]🔊[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/11777a49dfc93c6da7257f9dfd5fe66a9f93d322.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]AI Improvements 🧠[/h2][p]Two small changes have significantly enhanced the enemy AI:[/p][list][*][p][b]♟️Strategic Planning[/b]: The enemy now plans moves ahead, selecting optimal tiles to attack your units on the next turn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎯Target Selection Optimization[/b]: The AI now chooses attack targets more effectively, especially when the damage exceeds the target’s health.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Other Changes ✨[/h2][list][*][p][b]🏆Clearer Game Objective[/b]: The game now more clearly highlights the goal of achieving [b]ten victories[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]🖥️Improved Interface[/b]: The active skills and defense panel in battles has been reduced in size to avoid overlapping with unit stats on the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p][b]📝Post-Game Survey[/b]: After exiting the game, a page with a [b]short survey[/b] about your demo experience will open. Please take a moment to share your thoughts—it’ll help make the demo even better![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]In Conclusion[/h2][p]While these patch notes may not seem as massive as previous ones, a lot of important work has been done. I hope you enjoy the game’s new look as much as I do! You can check out all the changes right now by downloading the demo via the link. Share your feedback on the patch, take part in the survey, and, of course, [b]add the game to your wishlist! ⭐[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

The main changes involve the combat interface; additionally, there are refinements to the animation system, fund reimbursement, and AI behavior, along with several important bug fixes.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/cf782e7b8cd5246cc538e48537fceafd2e2f4bf5.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Combat Interface Changes ⚔️[/h3][p]The combat interface is now significantly notes.title: Shop Logic & Interface Overhaul
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]This update is a little late, but I hope its scale makes up for the wait. Introducing the new patch![/p][h3][b]Key Feature: Progression System Overhaul[/b][/h3][p]The centerpiece of this update is the new unit acquisition system. Now, access to rarer units unlocks gradually as you play more battles.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Battles Played[/p][/th][th][p]Max Unit Rarity Unlocked[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]2[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Uncommon[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]4[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]6[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Epic[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]8[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]After unlocking a new rarity tier, you are guaranteed access to at least one unit of that tier and all previous tiers.[/p][p]To balance this new system, 3 new [b]Common[/b] units have been added (Hunter, Lumberjack, Smith) and one [b]Legendary[/b] unit—the Archmage. The balance of all existing units has also been completely reworked.[/p][p]The new goal of the game is to reach [b]10 victories[/b]. After that, you can either reset your progress and start over or enter the [b]"Playoffs"[/b] mode. From now on, only the results from the Playoffs will be counted on the leaderboard. These changes are designed to give players more intermediate goals and to make the appearance of units in the shop more predictable and fair.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467507/62d07866a3fd9208dd2a57e0c2eab8a27026cd6b.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Interface Update: Shop and Army Management[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Shop:[/b] Units can now be purchased with a single click, which better fits the dynamic nature of the game. Additionally, merchant tips have been added to the shop to help new players get started.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Army Management:[/b] New convenient features have been added:[/p][list][*][p][b]Double-click:[/b] Splits a squad in half.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drag and drop:[/b] Allows you to split off any number of units from a squad.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Right-click:[/b] Disbands a squad.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Other Improvements and Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The battle results screen has been redesigned to better match the updated gameplay dynamics.[/p][/*][*][p]Added hoof clatter sound for cavalry.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AI: It now more actively protects its ranged units.[/p][/*][*][p]The compensation system for lost units has been rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the playback speed of the movement sound.[/p][/*][*][p]The cursor has been redesigned and is now dynamic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed starting a battle twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed entering the shop before bonus money was calculated.[/p][/*][/list][p]I hope you enjoy these changes! I look forward to your feedback. Play the game, share your impressions, and don't forget to add it to your Wishlist![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: No More Playing in Silence!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm thrilled to announce the release of a new patch: sound has finally arrived in the game! The interface, units, and environment now have voices. This is just the first step – in the future, individual units and arenas will get their unique sound effects.

Another important new feature: you can now retreat from battle. This won't grant rewards or refund lost units, but it will save your surviving units, opening up a new strategic option in tough fights. Plus, you can finally access the settings menu right in battle to change the language or adjust the volume.

A huge thanks to everyone supporting the project and adding the game to their wishlist!

Please keep it up and share your thoughts on the update in the comments!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/

notes.title: New Initiative and Rarity Systems
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
Meet the unscheduled update for the Knight's Errand demo version. Last week, I found out that players from China couldn’t access the server to upload their armies or download others’. So, this week, the game has been switched to a different backend. I hope this resolves all issues for everyone. However, if you enter a battle and there are no enemy units, please let me know!

[b]Other changes in this patch:[/b]
[list]
[*] The initiative system has been reworked. Units are now strictly divided by initiative level. This change aims to enhance the tactical aspect of unit selection during a player’s turn.
[*] Unit levels have been replaced with rarity. This change is intended to encourage players to think more about specific units as a whole, rather than just buying the highest-level ones.
[*] Alongside the introduction of rarity, the shop generation system has been revamped. The shop’s assortment should now be more diverse and fair. This isn’t the final version, and I’ll continue refining this aspect based on feedback.
[*] The internal unit naming system is now much more reliable. This ensures that players’ armies will be preserved between patches, regardless of changes to the project’s structure.
[*] All buttons with V and X icons have been replaced with context-appropriate words. This is meant to make the game interface more intuitive.
[/list]  
[b]AI behavior changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] AI units no longer stand still, even if they can’t find a direct path to their target.
[*] AI units use defense less often and move the maximum distance more frequently.
[/list]  
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The unit stats screen is now always centered on the screen.
[*] A player’s unit no longer skips its turn if there are no free cells around for movement.
[*] Ranged attacks now work correctly when the target is surrounded.
[/list]  
Add the game to your wishlists, try the demo, and share your thoughts in comments and reviews.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/

notes.title: Demo is out!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

I am pleased to announce the release of the demo version of the Tournament mode! In this game, you assemble an army and fight against the avatars of other players. So far, the game features only one faction — humans and 10 of their units. So far, this is more of a prototype than a full-fledged demo version. It includes about 10% of the future game's features and 1% of the final content.

Play, share your opinion in the reviews and add the game to your wish list if you see potential in the demo! 

Good luck and have a good game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678830/Knights_Errand_Demo/
